verdict.rationale: Bolt's own GitHub integration connects a repository, syncs commits automatically, and works across branches, so code can leave the platform for local work, and repositories can be imported. However, the evidence never states that commits made locally are pulled back into the Bolt project. missing for 10: explicit documentation of two-way sync where local pushes update the Bolt project, a documented local-editor/CLI workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of the round-trip.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work on the app locally with my own editor and tooling and push changes back to the platform

citations.quote: Connect a GitHub repository to back up your Bolt project, sync commits automatically, and work across branches.
Connecting GitHub to Bolt lets you automatically back up your Bolt project with a full history of changes that lives outside Bolt.
